identity.statusNote: yousign.com now 301-redirects to youtrust.com; the company is transitioning its brand from Yousign to Youtrust in 2026, expanding from e-signature to a broader digital trust platform (Sign, Verify, Seal).

keyLimits.en: Higher signature volume than One plan; billed annually at approximately 276 EUR/year

cautions.en: Qualified Electronic Signature (QES) is billed per signing party, roughly 10-15 EUR each, on top of the base plan; 50 QES signatures a month can add 500-750 EUR to the bill.

These prices were confirmed only via a secondary source (Verdocs) since the official pricing page redirected to the new Youtrust domain during this research pass; verify directly on youtrust.com before use.

capabilities.en: Electronic signature for quotes, contracts, engagement letters and client approvals, supporting Simple (SES) and Advanced (AES) electronic signature levels under eIDAS.
Identity verification workflows (ID card/passport, SMS validation) available for Advanced Electronic Signature.

limitations.en: No free plan; entry paid plan (One) is capped at 10 signatures per month, which may be insufficient for active use.
Qualified Electronic Signature is a separately priced add-on rather than included in standard plans.

reason.en: Direct e-signature competitor with a comparable feature set for contracts and approvals.
Established e-signature competitor targeting the same use case for contracts and approvals.
Competes for document signing plus proposal/contract workflow budget.

missingAlternatives.name: SignRequest
missingAlternatives.reason: Already listed as a candidate; simpler, lower-cost e-signature competitor not currently in the catalogue as a full entry

unknowns: Official pricing page could not be read directly during this session because yousign.com now 301-redirects to youtrust.com; plan prices above come from a secondary source (Verdocs) and should be reverified on youtrust.com/en-us/pricing.
Whether the Yousign brand and product will fully disappear in favor of Youtrust, or coexist, is not fully clear from available sources.
